payload.objective: Independently compare the final candidate against the original frozen/planner acceptance and Worker/Tester evidence, then rerun exactly one Tester-declared deterministic command under identical conditions.
scope: Review the original Planner criteria and frozen Charter/Gate3/C3 sources for fidelity; compare final candidate, release audit, Worker package evidence and final Tester evidence.
Independently rerun the declared deterministic command with exact executable, args, cwd, inputs, and candidate, capturing raw output and normalized stdout hash.
Save a closed Reviewer job.report and raw execution evidence under reports/councilflow-finalization/reviewer/. Do not edit source or repair findings.
instructions: Canonical root E:\Saint\PROJECTS\CouncilFlow-main; baseline HEAD 2d695a22a1bb596a527b0d118edc073d6d25553f. Final package SHA 903baa09e45485c393fee77a12b5520ce7045531363b519d418a683730a95f3f; 115 entries.
Compare exact original criteria from plan.json against frozen sources and approved C3 erratum; do not accept paraphrase or changed frozen criteria. Preserve historical failures as historical.

Review final Tester report CF-M014 and all top-level evidence_refs; check linkage to exact final candidate, raw suite outputs, command conditions, input/candidate hashes, example/integrity/fidelity results, and transparent Windows symlink skip.

Independently validate release archive contains zero retired standalone matching paths/text and excludes the three stale historical delivery/status reports. Distinguish immutable history exceptions and avoid calling them active capability.

Rerun exactly the Tester-declared command in reports/councilflow-finalization/tester-final/tester-deterministic-command.json. Executable, arguments, cwd, candidate, input refs, exit and CRLF-to-LF normalized stdout SHA-256 must be recorded. Compare exit and normalized output hash to Tester. Save raw bytes and hashes.

Do not execute Gate 3; do not claim host activation, loaded TOML identity, host isolation, junction/TOCTOU safety or unavailable-MCP dynamic fallback without direct evidence. Reviewer assesses technical evidence, not primarily UX.
